changes.rationale: Package planning now parses bounded JSON through one duplicate-key-rejecting typed schema with deny-unknown-fields on the manifest and every fixed-shape nested object. Required name, strict semver, non-placeholder description, and Harness skills are validated; supported metadata, interface, app, MCP, and asset fields remain bounded. Unsupported hooks and unknown fields reject rather than silently becoming package authority.

Every declared path must use a normalized confined ./ reference. Exact resources bind to one exact package entry; skills bind to a nonempty subtree containing at least one SKILL.md. ASCII-case aliases, duplicate references, missing targets, empty subtrees, overlapping roots, and unreferenced package bytes reject.

Exact app, MCP, interface-asset, and local-executable references require Data or Executable roles as appropriate. Skill subtrees preserve Skill, Executable, Agent, Documentation, and Data roles for SKILL.md, scripts, agent descriptors, references, and assets instead of falsely forcing every skill resource to one role.

The realistic positive fixture covers rich metadata, interface fields, inline local/remote MCP, app, assets, screenshots, mixed-role skill resources, deterministic reversed input order, and zero-write planning. Negatives cover the old name/version-only pass, missing description/skills, unsupported and nested unknown fields, duplicate keys, malformed semver, placeholder/control values, hostile paths, duplicate/case-alias refs, missing/empty targets, wrong roles, unreferenced data/executables, malformed MCP, and oversize input.

The stale NODE-004 install helper now consumes the same typed supported manifest and skill closure as package tests. Production InstallEffects, PackageEffects, compare-exchange, conditional rollback, and PackageSink behavior are unchanged.

NODE-004 expected-state package output transitions, install transitions, conditional rollback, concurrent-mutation preservation, and special-file controls remain green in the complete 30-test distribution suite.
